title: dedicated-capacity-weekly-prep-liam-chen-2026-03-11
content:
Weekly prep notes for dedicated capacity sync (1:1 + weekly).

Context / Objective:
- Align on next 12-week GPU pool forecast for Dedicated customers.
- Decide any reservation increases for A100/H100 pools before end of quarter.
- Review autoscaling policy adjustments and hot/cold pool thresholds.

Meeting agenda (15-30m):
1) Quick status (2m): current utilization across pools
2) Forecast recap (5m): growth signals from hosted, committed customers
3) Reservation asks & finance tradeoffs (6m)
4) Autoscaling policy proposals (8m)
5) Action items & owners (4m)

Current snapshot (2026-03-10):
- A100-40GB pool: allocated 48 GPUs, utilization 72% steady (P95 latency within SLO)
- H100-80GB pool: allocated 24 GPUs, utilization 88% peak during US morning; some queuing observed
- Mixed/FP16 pool (g4/g5-equivalent): 12 GPUs, utilization 40% (mostly low-priority batch jobs)
- Open capacity (unreserved): ~10 GPUs across regions (can be rebalanced)
- Reserved commits this quarter: 60 A100, 30 H100 (includes early renewals)

Recent signals & requests:
- Sales: 2 mid-market customers (expected to convert next 6 weeks) asking for guaranteed H100 capacity (10 GPUs combined) starting 2026-04-15 (JIRA CAP-4821)
- Hosted API: small but steady uptick in long-context workloads (L=16k) driving H100 spikes during EU business hours
- Internal experiments: research team needs a temporary 4x H100 burst for 3 weeks (request submitted via GH infra PR #456)

12-week forecast (high level):
- Conservative case: +8 A100 GPUs, +12 H100 GPUs (mainly from 2 customers + hosted growth)
- Base case (most likely): +16 A100, +20 H100
- Upside (if 3rd enterprise deal closes): +24 A100, +32 H100

Reservation recommendation:
- Approve increasing H100 reservation by +16 GPUs (from 30 -> 46) to cover committed customers + buffer for hosted spikes. Rationale: H100 shortage risk in region, price advantage when reserved vs on-demand.
- Hold A100 reservations steady this month; monitor usage for 2 weeks (we have slack capacity and cheaper burst options).
- Finance note: incremental reservation commit estimated $Xk/month (see linked Confluence cost model). Need sign-off from finance for >$50k MRR-equivalent commits.

Autoscaling policy proposals (short):
- Reduce cooldown on H100 hot-pool from 600s -> 300s for faster scale-in after spike (safeguard: min-run-time 300s to avoid churn).
- Introduce soft-capacity threshold: when H100 regional utilization >85% for 10m, route low-priority hosted requests to A100-quantized variants (fallback path).
- Add proactive scale-up: when queue depth >10 requests for 30s, automatically spin up reserved-backed burst instances (if available) before using on-demand.

Risks / open questions:
- If we commit +16 H100 and enterprise deal delays, finance exposure grows; what is acceptable runway (3 months vs 6 months)?
- Cross-region balancing: can we shift some EU H100 to US for daytime demand? Network latency tradeoffs for customers need review.
- Autoscaling churn: faster cooldowns may increase instance churn and GPU allocation overhead - need SRE input on cost vs latency benefit.

Proposed action items (owner, due):
- [Liam] Draft reservation purchase PO for +16 H100 and circulate to Finance: due 2026-03-13
- [Maya] Confirm enterprise contract timing with Sales + clarify start date for reserved capacity: due 2026-03-12
- [Ryan] Run a 48h simulation of faster H100 cooldown (600s -> 300s) in staging and report CPU/GPU churn metrics: due 2026-03-16
- [Jenna] Update fallback routing config for A100-quantized variant and run canary (5% traffic) to validate quality: due 2026-03-18
- [Liam] Add short note to Confluence with revised cost projection and break-even analysis for reservation delta: due 2026-03-14 (linked in artifacts)

Notes to self / talking points for 1:1 with Eng Manager:
- Emphasize tradeoff: reservation reduces unit cost but increases fixed spend - propose a 3-month trial for incremental H100 commit.
- Ask for SRE bandwidth to validate autoscaler changes (2-3 engineer-days).
- Highlight downstream impact: Console dashboard should show 'reservation-backed capacity' tag so CS can sell with confidence.

Follow-ups after meeting:
- Update this doc with final reservation decision and link to purchase order
- Create a short runbook to handle failed reservation fulfillment (fallback: expand on-demand pool + notify customers)

Quick links / refs (for meeting):
- Confluence: Dedicated-Capacity-Strategy-2026 (cost model + historical utilization)
- JIRA CAP-4821 (enterprise reservation request)
- GH infra PR: repo/infra#456 (research burst request + temp quota change)

Live metrics to glance at before meeting:
- Grafana: dedicated.capacity.overview (P95 latency, queue depth, per-pool util)
- Billing: reserved.vs.on-demand.monthly

End.
